description: Independent Astra and Claude bilingual editions, with Sol research and separate review.

articles.model: GPT-6 Astra Medium · Sol source/completeness review
articles.availability_note: Status follows NASA’s November 19, 2026 update. Perseverance’s radio issues and Odyssey’s reaction-wheel problem are separate. Both retain contact; science is paused. Backup-radio power differs from data rate, and Odyssey’s one–two-month fuel estimate assumes thruster-only orientation while estimates are refined. A wheel moving in one test differs from confirmed recovery. Restart dates are goals. Primary status and network descriptions were inspected; diagnostic logs, fuel measurements and later recovery outcomes were not independently verified.

articles.availability_note: 状态依据NASA于2026年11月19日的通报。毅力号无线电与奥德赛号反作用轮各有故障，两者仍保持联系，科学工作暂停。备用无线电功率与数据率不同；奥德赛号一至两个月燃料估计以仅靠推进器定向为前提，估计仍在修订。一次测试能转动与确认恢复不同，复工日期属于目标。本文查阅状态与网络说明，未独立核实诊断日志、燃料测量或后续恢复结果。
